senses.label: Partnership obligations
senses.summary: A business's duties are what its partners owe each other and others under contract and law.
markers: a business owes what its members owe under contract and law

sources.note: Business partners in Athens: 'Callias' partners'; 'my partners and I made a small profit' on a tax farm.
Roman law of partnership (societas), written in Marcus's lifetime.

senses.label: The limited-liability company
senses.summary: A company is a legal person; its owners' liability is limited to their stake.
markers: a company is a legal person whose owners' liability is limited

senses.label: Corporate social responsibility
senses.summary: A company owes duties to workers, customers and the community, not only its owners.
markers: a company owes duties to workers, customers and the community beyond its owners

sources.citation: Howard Bowen, Social Responsibilities of the Businessman (1953)
